summary: Build an e-commerce/admin-enabled site with an advanced, responsive admin panel (auto-detect admin login), customizable admin theming, order management (including deletion/cancellation), and improved stability/bug reduction.
known_issues: Admin system is described as glitchy and does not pop up immediately when an admin is logged in.
Site is reported as buggy/glitchy overall.

existing_features.title: Fix and harden admin detection so admin-only UI appears immediately after an admin logs in (no missing/late admin button, no flicker, no incorrect Access Denied while permissions are still being determined).
Add an admin-only order deletion workflow so admins can delete an order when a customer cancels (with a confirmation step and immediate UI refresh).
Replace the current 'Reset All Data' behavior with a correct, admin-only backend reset that actually deletes stored orders (and keep the frontend confirmation dialog aligned with the real behavior).
Create a distinct, advanced 'hacker/cool' theme for admin users/routes, visually separate from the regular site theme, and apply it consistently across /admin screens and admin-only components.
Add additional advanced admin panel features that improve operational control without changing the user ordering flow: searching, filtering, sorting, quick actions, and lightweight order insights.
Perform a focused bugfix/stability pass on admin flow and order management UI to reduce glitches (loading states, error handling, query invalidation, and empty/unauthorized states).

new_feature_requests.summary: Improve admin panel reliability and ensure it appears immediately when an admin is logged in (auto-detect/admin gating).
Add a custom 'hacker/cool' advanced theme for admin users (separate from regular user UI).
Add admin capability to delete/cancel orders (order deletion workflow for cancellations).
Expand admin panel with additional advanced features (enhanced tools/controls beyond current baseline).
Reduce site bugs/glitches and improve overall stability (bugfix pass, especially around admin flow).
Ensure the backend exposes a reliable admin-check method used by the frontend (e.g., `isCallerAdmin : query () -> async Bool`) and that admin gating does not depend on missing/unstable methods.

projectName: Upgrade admin system reliability, add hacker-themed admin UI, and enable order deletion
